source_documents.title: A Computational Protocol to Predict Anti-Kasha Emissions: The Case of Azulene Derivatives
Excited state dynamics of azulene and its derivatives: The impact of energy gap and vibronic coupling on anti-Kasha emission in solution

reference_evidence_units.quote: No sign of the S1S0 transition emission has been recorded on excitation at 220, 237, 269, 296 and 315 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene
reference_evidence_units.statement: No S1 emission is detected across these excitation wavelengths; S2 emission appears with the same envelope and excitation matches S0-to-S2 absorption.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Source notes S1 emission in literature under low-temperature laser excitation; absence is condition-specific.

reference_evidence_units.quote: there is such a Franck-Condon shift on photoexcitation that the geometry for emission is distinct to the geometry for absorption.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Absorption/emission corrected for Einstein frequency factors, Figure 6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors infer different absorbing/emitting geometries from absent mirror-image symmetry while retaining azulene as a true anti-Kasha exception.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Interpretation of spectra; no motion-restriction or aggregation experiment.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene 1a
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TVCF rates using ADC(2) energies/dipoles and DFT frequencies, 298 K; Table 2 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Calculated S1-to-S0 kr=1.6 x10^6, kIC=1.9 x10^11 s^-1; S2-to-S0 kr=2.7 x10^7 and S2-to-S1 kIC=6.3 x10^8 s^-1; S2 yield 4.3%, S1 yield 8.4 x10^-4%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Parentheses are external experimental values reused by F052: S2 yield 3.5 +/-0.4%, not a new measurement. Rates use harmonic approximations and gas-phase optimized geometries.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The vibronic features of the experimental S2 absorption and emission spectra are only recovered after the inclusion of HT effects
reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene 1a
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Franck-Condon versus Herzberg-Teller spectral calculations, Figure 3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Including HT terms improves vibronic spectral shape; FC-only spectra fail to reproduce positions/intensities.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Spectra are normalized and shifted to experimental 0-0 energies; shape agreement is not independent absolute-energy validation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: when comparing 1a and 1d, or 1b and 1e, they have almost the same S2-S1 adiabatic energy gap, but still a significantly different rate.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene 1a and substituted series
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Computed S2-to-S1 rates versus energy gaps and reorganization energies.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors attribute deviations from a simple gap-only trend to nonadiabatic couplings and total reorganization energies.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No assumption that all derivatives have identical rates, yields or accepting modes.

reference_evidence_units.quote: by 20 ps 90.5 % of the excited molecules occupy the S2 state, whereas 9.5 % occupy the S1 state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene Az
reference_evidence_units.conditions: LVC/MCTDH two-singlet model, B3LYP/TZP COSMO cyclohexane; selected 18 of 48 normal modes.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The simulated S2 population stays near 98% initially and reaches 90.5% at 20 ps.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Population fraction is not PLQY; excludes longer-time emission and full-dimensional nuclear dynamics. Symmetry-restricted model gives about 97% instead.

reference_evidence_units.quote: turning off Q33 halves the amount of the loss of the S2 population
reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene Az
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Virtual mode-ablation simulations; Q16/Q33/Q39 dominate selected-mode early dynamics.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Removing Q33 leaves about 94% S2 population; removing all three gives 98.7% at 20 ps (Table 2). Removing Q16 or Q39 alone has little effect.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Turning model modes off is not physical restriction in an aggregate. No RIM claim is inferred from this virtual intervention alone.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the rate constant of the internal conversion depends not only on the electronic energy gap, but also on vibronic couplings and molecular structure.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene Az with artificially changed gaps
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Az Hamiltonian with gaps changed to 1.10, 0.87 and 0.56 eV; Figure 6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Gap-adjusted Az curves differ from actual substituted-molecule curves, supporting coupling/structure dependence beyond energy gap.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Hypothetical gap perturbations are controls, not measurements of derivatives.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene and 2-substituted comparators
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F053 quotes external experimental reference 44 for solution PLQY.
reference_evidence_units.statement: F053 uses 2% for Az in its comparison, rather than F052's compiled 3.5 +/-0.4% or calculated 4.3%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: External values reported in main, not freshly measured here. Do not pool different source conditions or replace experimental yields with 20 ps populations.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the S1 state of azulene decays rapidly via an energetically achievable S1/S0 conical intersection
reference_evidence_units.subject: Azulene S1
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source explicitly invokes S1/S0 CI-mediated decay to explain absent S1 fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A cited mechanistic account, not a CI optimized or trajectory demonstrated by this two-excited-state study. No claim of restricted CI access on aggregation.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Competing S2 radiation/IC and very rapid S1 decay rationalize state-selective emission; rates and early dynamics are model-dependent.

reference_mechanisms.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain the explicit literature-based S1/S0 CI explanation with low evidential independence. This is CI-mediated decay, not proven RACI under aggregation.

reference_mechanisms.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
reference_mechanisms.rationale: All three linked sources support a bounded S2 anti-Kasha account through spectra, kinetic calculations and early dynamics.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No source-grounded restriction of intramolecular motion established for this target under the extracted conditions; emission or vibrations alone do not establish RIM.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific external packing or matrix confinement mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific binding of a guest, solvent or analyte that alters emission established.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific charge-transfer excited-state mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway established; hydrogen bonding or an OH substituent alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; CT-state character is not by itself a separate PET process.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex emission established; aggregation alone does not establish this family.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Competing S2 radiation/IC and very rapid S1 decay rationalize state-selective emission; rates and early dynamics are model-dependent.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer mechanism established by the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain the explicit literature-based S1/S0 CI explanation with low evidential independence. This is CI-mediated decay, not proven RACI under aggregation.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: All three linked sources support a bounded S2 anti-Kasha account through spectra, kinetic calculations and early dynamics.
